caption: Two friends sit in the back seat of a car, chatting, when the car brakes hard and both of them are thrown forward against their seat belts.
A stack of coins on the corner of a kitchen counter is knocked off by someone's elbow and the coins scatter on the floor.
A woman standing in the aisle of a bus holding the overhead rail sways backward as the bus pulls away from the stop.
A woman is jogging on a treadmill when the belt stops abruptly, and she lurches forward and grabs the handrails.
A parent gives a child on a playground swing one push and steps back, and the swing keeps going back and forth on its own before gradually dying down.
A phone lying flat on the dashboard of a car slides forward toward the windshield when the driver brakes suddenly at a red light.
A full cup of coffee sits in the cup holder of a car, and as the car turns sharply left the coffee sloshes up the right side of the cup and spills over the rim.
A child gives a shopping cart a push across an empty parking lot and lets go, and the cart rolls on by itself until it slows to a stop.
A boy takes a short run-up on a field, leaps forward off one foot, and after landing on both feet takes a few stumbling steps forward before he stops.
A family sits in the back seat of a car as it takes a sharp bend on a country road, and all of them lean toward the outside of the bend.
A waiter carrying a tray of full water glasses stops abruptly to avoid a running child, and the water sloshes forward and spills.
An adult pulling a toddler in a wagon stops walking suddenly, and the wagon rolls on a little and the toddler tips forward in the seat.
A bowler releases the ball at the top of the lane and it rolls the full length of the lane to the pins at the far end.
A ceiling fan running at full speed is switched off at the wall, and the blades keep turning for a while before coming to a stop.
A woman carrying groceries loses her grip on a bag of oranges at the top of a staircase, and the oranges tumble down the stairs to the bottom.
A skateboarder riding along a sidewalk hits a raised crack, the board stops dead, and the rider is thrown forward off the board.
A dog sprints across a smooth kitchen floor toward its food bowl, tries to stop in front of it, and skids past the bowl.
A spinning top is set going on a wooden table and left alone; it spins for a while, starts to wobble, and finally topples over.
A man shakes out a wet umbrella with a quick flick and stops his arm short, and the water drops fly off the tip and keep going in the direction of the flick.
A child lets go of a helium balloon on a string in a park and the balloon floats up into the sky.
A man on a ladder hands a hammer down to a helper, the helper misses it, and the hammer falls to the ground.
Autumn leaves come loose from a tree on a still afternoon and drift down to settle on the lawn.
A cat nudges a pen off the edge of a desk with its paw and the pen falls to the floor.
A waiter's hand slips, a ceramic plate drops from waist height onto a tiled restaurant floor, and it shatters.
A gardener turns a watering can upside down over a flower bed and the water pours out onto the soil.
A boy tosses a tennis ball straight up in his backyard and it comes back down into his open hands.
A child on a sled slides down a snowy slope, runs out onto a flat patch of bare grass, and stops within a short distance.
A jogger comes to a wide puddle on a path, jumps over it, and lands on the far side.
A large dog on a leash spots a squirrel and lunges after it; the leash snaps taut, the dog is stopped short, and the owner is jerked forward a step.
A cook cracks an egg on the rim of a bowl, pulls the shell apart above it, and the yolk and white drop into the bowl.
A gymnast lands feet-first in the centre of a trampoline, the mat stretches deep under her, and it throws her back up into the air.
A rubber ball rolls across a polished wooden floor onto a thick shaggy rug and comes to a stop on the rug.
A boy drops a stone into a still garden pond; it splashes, sinks, and ripples spread out across the water.
A referee flips a coin into the air at the start of a match and catches it as it comes down.
A worker pours a bucket of gravel slowly onto one spot on a flat concrete floor, and the gravel piles up into a cone.
A skydiver steps out of the open door of an airplane and drops away below it.
A diver stands at the end of a high platform, bends her knees, jumps off, and falls into the pool.
A woman hangs a basket of wet laundry from the middle of a clothesline strung between two posts, and the line sags under the weight.
A boy drops a water balloon from a second-floor balcony, and it falls straight down and bursts on the pavement.
A horse gallops across an open field from one end to the other.
A man presses a button on a vending machine, and a can drops inside the machine and lands in the tray at the bottom.
A driver tries to pull away from a snow-covered kerb, the car's rear wheels spin in place and throw up snow, and the car stays almost where it is.
A woman in smooth-soled shoes steps onto a patch of ice on a sidewalk, her foot slides forward, and she stumbles.
A tennis racket strikes a ball hard during a serve and the ball flies off toward the far court.
A coin is set spinning on its edge on a wooden table, wobbles, and falls flat.
A woman folds a letter into thirds and slides it into an envelope.
A boy rolls a hula hoop along a sidewalk and lets it go; it rolls on by itself, wobbles, and falls over.
A man throws a dart at a dartboard on a pub wall and it sticks in the board.
A horse and rider gallop toward a low fence, jump over it, and land on the far side.
A cook pours olive oil into a glass of water, and the oil gathers in a layer floating on top of the water.
A goalkeeper punts a soccer ball far down the field, and it lands and bounces near the far end.
A dolphin swimming fast bursts out of the sea, arcs through the air, and splashes back in.
A child holds a kite string as a steady wind lifts the kite, and the string pulls taut from her hand up to the kite.
A man lowers a bucket into a well on a rope and hauls it back up full of water.
A toddler on a beach lifts a handful of dry sand, opens her fingers, and the sand streams down onto the beach.
A woman tips a box of dry pasta into a pot of boiling water, and the pasta sinks and settles at the bottom.
A man sits down in an empty hammock strung between two trees, and the hammock sags deeply under him.
A truck backs up until the tow rope to a stuck car lies slack on the ground, then drives forward; the rope goes taut and the car jerks into motion behind it.
A baker presses the heel of her hand into a ball of bread dough on a floured counter and the dough flattens and spreads.
A picture frame hanging on a wall comes loose from its nail and falls to the floor.
A person sits down on a large cardboard box in a garage, the box caves in under them, and it stays crumpled when they stand up.
A white cue ball rolls straight into a red ball sitting still on a pool table; the red ball rolls away and the cue ball stops.
A car tire stood on its tread is pushed along a level driveway; it rolls a long way, wobbles, and topples flat.
A cat crouches on a kitchen floor, jumps up onto the counter, and lands on it.
A cook presses a ripe avocado firmly between finger and thumb and the skin dents inward and stays dented.
A child bends a fresh green twig into a curve, lets go of one end, and the twig springs back to nearly straight.
A motorboat speeds across a calm lake, leaving a spreading wake behind it.
A wheeled suitcase pulled from a smooth airport floor onto a cobblestone street starts bumping and rattling over the stones.
A woman tips a jar of honey over a slice of toast, and the honey flows out in a slow thick ribbon onto the toast.
A teacher draws a large circle on a blackboard with a piece of chalk, and a white line appears where the chalk has passed.
A kid drops a rubber ball from shoulder height onto a concrete driveway and it bounces several times before rolling away.
A child pulls a blanket off a bed and drags it across the floor behind her.
Two children in bumper cars drive straight at each other, meet head-on, and both cars bounce back a little.
A child blows through a straw into a glass of soapy water, and bubbles rise and pile up in a foam at the top of the glass.
A man tilts a half-full fish tank to one side while carrying it, and the water climbs the low side and spills over the rim.
A bowling ball reaches the end of the lane, hits the front pin of a full rack, and the pins fly and scatter.
A cat digs in a litter box with its front paws, flinging litter backward and leaving a hollow.
A tennis ball is thrown hard against a brick wall and bounces back toward the thrower.
A mover pushes against the side of a tall stack of cardboard boxes in a hallway and the stack topples, boxes tumbling to the floor.
A child drags a stick through a patch of loose gravel on a path, leaving a furrow behind it.
A girl pulls a block out of the bottom row of a tall wooden block tower and the tower collapses.
An angler's fishing line goes tight as a fish takes the bait, and the rod bends toward the water.
A gust of wind lifts a man's wide-brimmed hat off his head on a seafront and carries it away along the ground.
A bicycle is turned upside down, someone spins the front wheel by hand and steps back, and the wheel keeps spinning for a while before stopping.
A man rolls a heavy wooden barrel up a plank onto a truck bed, lets go halfway up, and the barrel rolls back down to the ground.
A boy blows up a balloon, lets go of the neck without tying it, and the balloon shoots off around the room until it drops limp to the floor.
A woman bends down, picks up a heavy box from the floor, and straightens up holding it.
A shopping cart rolls across a parking lot, runs into a concrete curb, and stops abruptly.
A child rolls a ball up a gentle grassy slope; it slows, stops, and rolls back down toward the child.
An archer draws a bowstring back to her cheek and releases it, and the arrow flies off toward the target.
A boy catches a ball thrown to him with both hands and holds on to it.
A child sits on a rope swing, a friend gives her a push, and she swings back and forth beneath the branch.
A child cuts a sheet of coloured paper in half with scissors, and the two halves fall apart on the table.
A finger tips over the first domino in a long row standing on a table, and the whole row falls one after another.
A girl rides a kick scooter along a path, pushing off the ground with one foot and gliding between pushes.
A bicycle resting on its kickstand is bumped by a passing pedestrian and falls over onto its side.
A man sitting in a dining chair leans back until only the two rear legs are on the floor, leans a little further, and tips over backward with the chair.
A cashier tears a sheet of wrapping paper from a roll and folds it around a shoebox, creasing the corners.
A swimmer does front crawl across a pool and reaches the far wall.
A toddler stacks plastic cups into a tower on a carpet, bats the top cup with his hand, and the top of the tower falls.
A wheelbarrow full of soil is pushed across a soft lawn, where its wheel sinks and drags, and then onto a paved patio, where it rolls easily.
A man tears a loaf of crusty bread in two with his hands at a dinner table.
A ball rolls across a living-room floor, disappears behind a sofa, and comes out the other side.
A cook slices a ripe tomato into rounds on a cutting board with a sharp knife.
A bartender drops several ice cubes into a glass of soda, and the cubes bob up and float near the surface.
A log is rolled off the back of a trailer onto a slight downhill slope and rolls down to the bottom.
A man places an upturned cup over a coin on a table, slides the cup to the side, and lifts it to reveal the coin.
A parent pulls a sled with a child on it across a snowy field by a rope, then stops, and the rope goes slack.
A cat pounces onto a spider web strung between two garden plants and the web tears apart under it.
A woman puts a set of keys into a small wooden box, closes the lid, then opens it again and takes the keys out.
A boat tied to a dock by a long line drifts away on the tide until the line goes taut and stops it.
A woman drops a dry sponge into a basin of water; it floats, darkens as it soaks up water, and settles lower.
A waiter's elbow knocks a full wine glass on a table; it tips over and the wine spills across the tablecloth.
A bucket of water is emptied over a concrete sidewalk, and the water spreads out in a thin sheet and runs toward the lower side.
A girl holds a dandelion clock up and blows hard on it, and the seeds detach and drift away.
A stepladder standing on a lawn is pushed sideways by a man, who then steps away, and the ladder falls over onto the grass.
A woman rips a strip of packing tape off a cardboard box and the box flaps come free.
A boy bites into a whole apple and takes a bite-shaped piece out of it.
A chef chops a carrot into rounds with quick knife strokes, and the pieces pile up beside the blade.
A desk fan is switched on next to a loose stack of papers, and the top sheets lift and scatter across the desk and floor.
A crane cable is hooked to a steel beam lying on the ground; the operator lifts, the cable tightens, and the beam rises off the ground.
A woman opens an umbrella on a windy street corner, and the wind tugs it sideways and flips the canopy inside out.
A man slips on a wet floor in a supermarket aisle and falls down.
A woman wrings out a soaked towel over a sink with both hands, and water streams out of it.
A cook tips a saucepan and pours soup into a bowl until it is full and begins to spill over the sides.
A dog climbs out of a lake and shakes itself, sending a spray of water droplets flying off its fur.
A woman paddles a kayak across a calm lake, pulling the blade back through the water, and the kayak moves forward.
A couple dances a slow waltz around a living room, holding each other.
A tailor tears a length of cotton fabric along a snipped edge, and the fabric rips into two pieces.
A man struggles to twist the lid off a tight jar and finally gets it open, lid in hand.
A woman walks along a street and passes behind a wide pillar, disappearing and then emerging on the far side.
A child pulls a tuft of cotton candy off the top of a cone and it comes away as a separate wisp.
Smoke rises from a house chimney on a calm winter evening and thins out as it climbs.
A child dips a wand in soap solution and blows a stream of bubbles in a park; the bubbles float away on the breeze and pop one by one.
A light curtain hanging in front of an open window billows into the room with each gust of wind and falls back between gusts.
A cat climbs into a paper grocery bag on the floor, and the bag rustles and shifts as the cat moves inside it.
A dodgeball hits a boy in the chest during a gym game, bounces off him, and drops to the floor.
A soccer ball kicked hard hits the goalpost squarely and rebounds back onto the field.
A baker pours a bag of sugar into a large mixing bowl, and the sugar builds up into a mound in the bowl.
A shopper drops three apples one by one into an empty cloth bag, and the bag sags and bulges.
A car in a parking lot rolls slowly forward, bumps into the back of a parked car, and stops.
A child turns a bucket packed with damp sand upside down on the beach and lifts it off, leaving a bucket-shaped sand tower standing.
A pigeon flies in and lands on a park railing.
A child does a forward roll on a gym mat and comes up sitting.
A man pushes a broken-down car along a flat street while a friend steers, and the car slowly starts to roll.
A father tosses a soft ball across the lawn to his daughter, who stands with her arms out, and the ball lands in her arms.
A skateboarder rolling along a flat path lowers his back foot and drags it on the ground, and the board slows and comes to a stop.
A woman aims a hairdryer at her long hair in front of a mirror, and her hair streams away from the nozzle.
A car drives onto a frozen pond, the driver turns the steering wheel sharply, and the car keeps sliding straight ahead instead of turning.
A groundskeeper points a leaf blower at a pile of dry leaves on a path, and the leaves scatter and tumble away from the nozzle.
A man pours a glass of water into an opaque metal jug, then tips the jug and pours the water back out into the glass.
A toy car is pushed into one end of a cardboard tunnel and rolls out the other end.
A man slides his arm into the sleeve of a coat and his hand emerges from the cuff.
A pyramid of empty soda cans at a carnival booth is hit by a tennis ball, and the cans fly off and fall to the counter.
A hockey puck slides along the ice, hits the metal goalpost, and deflects off at an angle.
A child taps the tall thin tower on top of a sandcastle with a shovel, and the tower crumbles and slides down the side of the castle.
A boy ties the laces of his sneaker into a bow and pulls the loops tight.
A snowman's head is knocked sideways by a thrown snowball, rolls off the body, and drops to the snow.
A woman folds a bath towel in half and then in half again, and sets the folded square on a shelf.
A hand squeezes a wet kitchen sponge over a sink, water streams out, and the sponge springs back to shape when the hand opens.
A gardener points a running hose upward at an angle over a vegetable bed and the water comes down on the far side of the bed.
A child stretches a rubber band between two fingers and lets one end slip; the band snaps back and drops.
A child hides behind a floor-length curtain, and the curtain bulges where she stands with her shoes showing beneath the hem.
A necklace catches on a door handle as a woman walks past; the chain goes tight and jerks her head back.
A toy train runs along a track, hits a wooden block someone has placed across the rails, and stops.
A dog walks into its doghouse and a moment later pokes its head back out of the doorway.
A teenager pulls the two sides of a bag of chips apart at the top seam and the bag pops open.
Two children sit on opposite ends of a seesaw; one slides off her seat and the other child's end drops to the ground.
A hiker snaps a dry twig in half between her hands with a crack.
A woman breaks a bar of chocolate along its grooves into separate pieces.
A teenager shoots a basketball from the three-point line and it drops through the hoop.
A dump truck tips its bed and unloads a pile of gravel onto a construction site, where it settles into a heap.
A man steps on an empty aluminum soda can lying on a driveway and it crumples flat and stays flat.
A bag of rice slips off a kitchen counter, splits open on the floor, and rice grains scatter across the floor.
A diner shakes a salt shaker over a plate of fries and salt grains fall onto the fries.
A boy slowly pushes a hardback book toward the edge of a table until it tips over the edge and falls to the floor.
A man blows out the candles on a birthday cake with one breath, and thin wisps of smoke rise from the wicks.
A host cuts a slice out of a round birthday cake and lifts it onto a plate, leaving a wedge-shaped gap in the cake.
A flag hanging limp from a pole outside a school lifts and streams out as a strong wind picks up.
A plastic shopping bag lying on an empty parking lot inflates and tumbles away across the lot as the wind rises.
A child presses both thumbs into a ball of modelling clay on a table, and the clay keeps the thumbprints after the hands lift away.
A woman rolls up a yoga mat from one end into a tight cylinder and stands it against the wall.
An hourglass is turned over on a desk, and sand runs from the top chamber into the bottom one.
A man crumples a sheet of paper into a tight ball in his fist and drops it on the desk.
A hiker unfolds a paper map on the hood of a car and smooths it out with her hands.
A man peels an orange with his thumbs, starting from a slit at the top, and the pieces of peel pile up beside the bare fruit.
A woman throws a blanket over a wooden chair, and the shape of the chair shows through the blanket.
A man tries to push a large hardcover book into a shoebox that is too small for it, and the book will not go in.
A camper opens the valve of an inflated air mattress and presses down on it, and the mattress hisses and sags flat.
A child drops a tennis ball into a bucket, then tips the bucket over and the ball rolls out onto the floor.
A gardener empties a bag of soil into a flower pot, filling it with a loose heap.
A golfer putts a ball, it hits the back of the cup's rim, pops up, and drops into the hole.
A gardener coils a long garden hose into loops on the lawn.
A man works a hand pump attached to a flat bicycle tyre, and the tyre fills out until it is firm and round.
A child on a moving swing lets go at the front of the arc, flies forward, and lands on the ground ahead of the swing.
A car drives along a road, passes behind a parked truck, and reappears on the far side of it.
A man shakes out a tablecloth and lets it settle over a dining table, and the edges hang down over the sides.
A student balances a stack of textbooks on the palm of one hand, tilts the hand to one side, and the books slide off and fall to the floor.
A child pushes a coin into the slot of a piggy bank and then shakes the bank, and the coin rattles inside.
A woman pushes down on a foam pillow with one hand, lifts the hand away, and the pillow puffs back to its shape.
A man swings an axe down onto a log standing on end on a chopping block, and the log splits into two pieces that fall apart to the sides.
A man walks barefoot across a stretch of dry beach sand, leaving a trail of footprints behind him.
A feather is dropped in front of a running box fan and is carried away by the airflow before drifting to the floor.
A child folds a sheet of paper step by step into a paper airplane.
A man pulls the rope on a flagpole hand over hand, and the flag rises up the pole as the rope runs through the pulley at the top.
A curling stone glides down the ice, strikes another stone sitting in the house, and knocks it away while itself slowing to a stop.
A boy throws a flat stone sideways low over a calm lake, and it skips across the surface several times before sinking.
A cyclist comes to a stop at a light with both feet still on the pedals, the bicycle leans to one side, and cyclist and bike fall over together.
A boy jumps onto the middle of a bed, the mattress dips under him, and he bounces slightly before settling.
A student tears a page out of a spiral notebook, leaving a fringe of paper on the coil.
A man shovels a heap of snow off a driveway onto the lawn, building a ragged pile there.
A woman walks along a city sidewalk carrying a handbag, one foot after the other.
A camper pulls the drawstring of a cloth bag, and the bag's opening gathers shut.
A child grabs the handle of a backyard zip line and rides it down to the far end, the cable sagging under her weight.
Two people walking around a corner in an office hallway bump shoulders and are both knocked a step sideways.
A lawn sprinkler sends jets of water up and out over a garden, and the water falls onto the grass some distance away.
A ping-pong ball served across the table clips the edge of the receiver's paddle and flies off sideways.
A cook balances a wooden spoon across the rim of a pot, sets a heavy ladle on one end, and the spoon tips and the ladle falls into the pot.
A basketball thrown from the free-throw line hits the front of the rim, bounces up, and falls to the floor.
A child rolls a beach ball across the sand into an upright plastic bucket, and the ball stops while the bucket is nudged over.
A batter connects with a pitch, sends the baseball high into the outfield, and it comes down into a fielder's glove.
A man bends a metal paper clip open with his fingers, lets go, and the clip stays in its new shape.
A snowball thrown across a snowy yard hits a friend on the shoulder and bursts into loose snow.
A frog on a lily pad leaps toward the bank of a pond and lands on it.
A person carrying a stack of dinner plates in one hand trips on a rug, and the plates slide off and shatter on the floor.
A gardener cuts through a thick garden hose with a pair of shears, leaving two open ends.
A child climbs an unanchored bookshelf and pulls on the top; the shelf tips forward and falls, spilling books.
Two teams pick up a slack rope lying on the grass and begin a tug of war; the rope goes taut and the middle marker moves toward the stronger side.
A child presses a hand into a slab of memory foam, lifts it away, and the hand-shaped dent slowly fills back in.
A cook pours dried beans from a bag into a glass jar until it is full and beans spill over onto the counter.
A man squeezes an inflated balloon between his palms; it flattens between his hands and bulges out at the sides, then rounds out again when he lets go.
A child packs loose snow between mittened hands into a firm snowball that holds its shape when the hands open.
A boy pulls a stubborn weed out of the soil by its leaves, and the whole plant comes up with its roots and clinging soil.
A man jogs across a park lawn from one side to the other.
A woman pours water from a jug into an empty drinking glass on a table until the glass is nearly full.
A child knocks over a full glass of milk on a kitchen table, and the milk spreads across the table and drips off the edge.
A farmer scatters a handful of seed across bare soil with a sweep of his arm, and the seeds land spread over a wide patch.
A woman hangs a wet shirt on a clothesline by its shoulders, and the shirt hangs down and drips.
A barista knocks a used coffee filter against the rim of a bin, and the puck of wet grounds drops out and breaks apart in the bin.
A child kicks the top of a small pile of dry sand in a sandbox, and sand sprays forward and leaves a gouge in the pile.
A boy climbs a flight of stairs two at a time and reaches the top.
A girl sucks on a straw standing in a glass of juice, and the juice climbs the straw into her mouth while the level in the glass goes down.
An elderly man lowers himself into an armchair and sits down.
A dog runs across a yard, picks up a ball in its mouth, and runs back.
A man wraps a long scarf around his neck twice and tucks the end in.
A sailor ties a knot in a thick rope and pulls both ends hard so the knot tightens.
A mover unrolls a rolled-up rug across a wooden floor with a push, and the rug lies flat.
A cook squeezes a plastic ketchup bottle over a plate of fries, and ketchup comes out of the nozzle onto the fries.
A boy pushes an inflated beach ball under the water in a swimming pool and lets go, and the ball pops back up to the surface.
A woman runs a vacuum cleaner nozzle over crumbs scattered on a carpet, and the crumbs disappear into the nozzle.
A soccer ball kicked hard hits the goalpost squarely and rebounds back onto the field.

caption: Two people walking around a corner in an office hallway bump shoulders and are both knocked a step sideways.
